description.value:
Tata Consultancy Services Limited provides information technology (IT) and IT enabled services.

Business Segments

The company operates in several business segments that encompass a broad range of IT services, consulting, and solutions tailored to meet the unique needs of its clients across various industries. The primary segments include IT Services, Consulting, Digital Transformation Services, and Managed Services.

IT Services

This segment encompasses a wide array of offerings, such as application development and maintenance, infrastructure management, and enterprise solutions.

Consulting

This segment focuses on delivering strategic business insights and solutions. Through its industry-focused consulting approach, the company helps businesses reimagine their operations and develop comprehensive strategies that drive growth while minimizing risks.

Digital Transformation Services

This segment offers solutions, such as cloud computing, analytics, and artificial intelligence enabling organizations to thrive in the rapidly evolving digital landscape.

Managed Services

This segment focuses on delivering extensive support and streamlined operations while allowing clients to concentrate on their core competencies. By providing end-to-end management of IT systems, the company enables businesses to maximize return on investment and maintain a competitive edge in their respective markets.

Business Strategy

The company's business strategy is centered around innovation and customer-centricity. In addition, the company embraces a proactive approach toward sustainability and environmental responsibility, integrating these principles into its business practices.

Products and Services

The company offers a comprehensive range of products and services that cater to diverse industry needs. These span across various technological domains, including:

Application Services: End-to-end development, maintenance, and management of applications.

Cloud Services: Comprehensive cloud solutions enabling seamless migration, deployment, and management.

Enterprise Solutions: Implementation of enterprise resource planning (ERP) systems tailored to enhance business processes.

Analytics and Insights: Advanced data analytics services that drive informed decision-making through enhanced data visibility.

Cybersecurity: Robust security solutions that safeguard business assets and crucial information against evolving cyber threats.

IoT Services: Solutions focused on integrating connected devices and enhancing operational efficiencies.

Digital Experience Solutions: Enhancing customer engagement through cutting-edge digital marketing and customer experience management.

Geographical Markets Served

The company operates on a global scale serving clients across various regions, including North America, Europe, Asia Pacific, Latin America, and the Middle East.

Customers

The company serves a diverse range of customers across various industries, including banking, financial services, insurance, healthcare, retail, telecommunications, and manufacturing. The clientele represents a mix of Fortune 500 firms, government entities, and small- to mid-sized enterprises showcasing the company’s ability to cater to varied business needs and scales.

Sales and Marketing

The company utilizes a multifaceted approach to sales and marketing that includes direct sales, partnerships, and digital marketing strategies. The direct sales force works closely with clients to understand their requirements and tailor solutions specifically to meet their needs.

Partnerships with other technology and consulting firms allow the company to broaden its service offering and reach. Additionally, the company employs digital marketing techniques that leverage online platforms to enhance brand visibility and engage potential clients through targeted campaigns.

History

Tata Consultancy Services Limited was founded in 1968. The company was incorporated in 1995.

description_short.value: Tata Consultancy Services Limited provides information technology (IT) and IT enabled services. It offers TCS ADD, a suite of AI powered life sciences platforms; TCS BaNCS, a financial services platform; TCS BFSI Platforms, a cloud-native, subscription-based as-a-service digital ecosystem for insurers and financial firms; TCS Chroma, a cloud-based AI-led hire-to-retire modular platform; TCS Customer Intelligence & Insights, an AI-powered, real-time customer data analytics solution; TCS ERP on Cloud, SAP transformation with AI-powered smart solutions; ignio, a cognitive automation software product; TCS iON, a learning ecosystem; and TCS HOBS, a cloud-native, catalog-centric platform with composable architecture and insights-led personalization capabilities. It also offers TCS Intelligent Urban Exchange for enterprises and smart cities; TCS OmniStore, a retail commerce platform; TCS Optumera, a strategic intelligence platform; TCS Tap, a platform for intelligent procurement; Quartz, a distributed ledger technology; TCS TwinX, a risk-free experimentation platform; TCS MasterCraft, an AI-driven cognitive automation product; Jile, an enterprise agile planning and delivery tool; TCS DigiBOLT, an end-to-end, organization-wide enterprise platform; and TCS AI WisdomNext, an enterprise grade GenAI platform. In addition, the company provides AI, data and analytics, cloud, cognitive business, consulting, cybersecurity, enterprise solutions, industrial autonomy and engineering, network solutions and services, TCS interactive, and sustainability services. It serves banking; capital markets; consumer packaged goods and distribution; communications, media, and information services; education; energy, resources, and utilities; healthcare; high tech; insurance; life sciences; manufacturing; public services; retail; and travel and logistics industries. The company was founded in 1968 and is based in Mumbai, India. The company operates as a subsidiary of Tata Sons Private Limited.

Advanced Drug Development Platform:
Advanced Drug Development platform is transforming clinical research, by harnessing digital technologies to minimize human intervention.

Advanced Process Control Solutions:
Advanced Process Control (APC) solutions for modeling and optimization of systems for mineral and metal processing plants.

Analytics & Insights Services:
Analytics & Insights Services can help you analyze the business environment accurately and predict future trends. - Client Challenges - Capability to analyze silos of data across various functional units - Access to a skilled and experienced talent pool - Availability of analytics-specific tools and technology - What TCS Provides.

APAC Digital Sustainability Index:
APAC-focused Digital Sustainability Index will evaluate current sustainability efforts undertaken by companies and governments, identify digital sustainability market leaders in the region, and uncover the factors critical to the development of sustainable digital solutions. A research report will uncover deep insights into key digital sustainability efforts around the region and rank these via the Index. The new index will track the adoption and leverage of digital technologies by enterprises for their growth and transformation, and for discharging their social and environmental responsibilities, to create longer term value for all stakeholders.

AURA Dealer Business Management Golden Template:
AURA Dealer Business Management (DBM) Golden Template, a new predefined service based on an innovative, business-ready and lean model built for the auto retail sector. The AURA DBM Golden Template is a result of co-innovation and joint development efforts between TCS and SAP. The new AURA service has been built on the SAP ERP and SAP Dealer Business Management applications. The service is offered in the form of a packaged implementation service that can help jump start business operations of auto retailers and contains standard baseline functionality, best practices and end-to-end process scenarios for sales, service, parts business, finance, human resources and their related reports. As a fixed-cost service provided in a ready-to-deploy and out-of-the-box format, AURA reduces implementation time, provides an increased return on investment and facilitates gradual, stage-wise customization and change management.
